description: Paid ($0.15 USD). Bundle: is a tokenized real-world asset on the XRP Ledger growing, and who holds it, in one call and one payment. Supply, holders (trustlines), 7 and 30-day growth and top-holder share from the XR-Pulse RWA tracker, 30 days of daily supply changes, tracked AMM pools, the issuer's XR-Trust permissioned-domain role and a 90-day XR-Ledger statement of the issuer wallet. Amounts are in the token's own unit. Returns summary, key_numbers and sections. An issuer that is not tracked returns 404 and is not charged.

currency.description: Currency code. Needed only when the issuer has more than one tracked token.

issuer.description: Issuer wallet (r...) of a tracked RWA token.
